name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B
short: NVIDIA's open-weight 120B/12B-active Mamba-Transformer vision-language MoE (1M context) for multimodal and video agents; AA Index 26.5, OpenMDW-1.1.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: The vision-language open-weight with an exotic twist: a Mamba-Transformer hybrid MoE tuned for video-length multimodal agents.
tradeoff: A modest general-quality index and a young NVIDIA toolchain make it a specialist pick rather than a general assistant.
